name: easymail
description: Local Outlook digest collection, Copilot analysis, and dashboard for classic Outlook.

easyMail.recentHours.description: Pull mails received within the last N hours.

easyMail.maxItems.description: Maximum number of mails to pull.

easyMail.folders.description: Outlook folders to scan. Prefer the EasyMail: Select Outlook Folders command to load available folders from Outlook, or enter names/paths such as Inbox, Sent Items, Inbox/Project, or Mailbox Name/Inbox. Inbox-only legacy values are expanded to Inbox and Sent Items.

easyMail.bodyExcerptChars.description: Maximum body characters per mail sent to Copilot.

easyMail.sampleMode.description: Generate sample mail data instead of reading Outlook.

easyMail.draftLanguage.description: Draft reply language. Auto follows the source mail or thread language.

easyMail.autoAnalyzeMaxClassificationLev.description: Maximum mail classification level allowed for analysis.

easyMail.mailStoreRetentionDays.description: Raw local mail queue retention days.

easyMail.meetingDaysAhead.description: Collect meetings within the next N days from Outlook calendar.

easyMail.collectorTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the Outlook mail/meeting collector scripts. Increase for large mailboxes or slow Outlook cold starts.

easyMail.importantSenders.markdownDescription: Important senders, mail groups, or keywords matched into `importantSender`. Examples: `person@example.com`, `team-alerts@company.com`, `Customer A`, `Project Phoenix`.

easyMail.ignoredSenders.markdownDescription: Unanalysed mail whose sender display name or email address contains any entry is placed in Ignored. Matching is case-insensitive. Examples: `no-reply@example.com`, `System Notifications`.

easyMail.modelFamily.description: Copilot model identifier. Recommended: choose an available model with EasyMail: Load Copilot Models and the dashboard model dropdown. Manual Settings entry is fallback only.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with EasyMail
walkthroughs.description: Collect local Outlook mail, review pending items, and analyze with GitHub Copilot.

steps.title: Open the Dashboard
steps.description: Open the EasyMail view from the Activity Bar. Use the language button in the top-right corner to switch between English and Simplified Chinese.

steps.title: Configure Mail Range
steps.description: Click Settings, then More Settings (VS Code Settings), to edit mail range, folders, retention, and security settings. Use EasyMail: Select Outlook Folders to load folder choices from Outlook. Use Load Models and the Analysis Model dropdown in the dashboard for model selection.

steps.title: Fetch New Mail
steps.description: Click Fetch New to collect recent Outlook mail. After the first fetch, More History becomes available for loading older mail per folder.

steps.title: Analyze with Copilot
steps.description: Choose an Analysis Model from the dashboard, then run Analyze Next Batch, Analyze Selected, or Analyze All Allowed.

commands.title: EasyMail: Analyze Next Batch with Copilot
